cards.text: Jesus is teaching in the temple courts, and the chief priests and scribes just tried to trap Him with a question about His authority (Luke 20:1-8). Now He turns to the people and tells them a parable. A man plants a vineyard, rents it out to some tenants, and goes away for a long time.

cards.question: Harvest time comes, and the vineyard owner sends a servant to the tenants. What is the servant there to collect?

answers.text: The owner's share of the fruit
A year of rent in silver

cards.text: The tenants beat the servant and send him away empty-handed. Friend, he came to pick up a share of the harvest and left with a share of the BRUISES.

cards.question: The owner sends another servant to the tenants. True or false: this time the tenants treat him kindly and pay up.
The second servant gets beaten, shamed and sent off with nothing. Then the owner sends a third servant. What do the tenants do to him?

answers.text: They wound him and throw him out
They give him the owner's share
They hire him to work the vines

cards.text: Three servants sent. Three servants back with NOTHING. The owner asks, 'What shall I do?' and baker, if I sent three helpers to pick up a cookie order and they all came back like that, I'd be hiding under the counter in my apron.

cards.question: True or false: after the three servants, the vineyard owner decides to send his beloved son.
The vineyard owner sends his son, hoping the tenants will ___ him.

cards.text: The son walks up, and the tenants see him coming. They huddle up, talk it over, and say, 'This is the heir.'

cards.question: The tenants plan to kill the owner's son, the heir. What do they think they'll get out of it?

cards.text: They throw the son out of the vineyard and kill him. Then Jesus asks, "What then will the owner of the vineyard do to them?"

cards.question: Jesus answers His own question about the vineyard owner. True or false: the owner will forgive the tenants and let them keep the vineyard.
Jesus says the owner will come, kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others. How do the people react when they hear it?

cards.text: The people say, "May such a thing never happen!" Jesus looks directly at them and asks what this Scripture means: "The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone" (Psalm 118:22).

cards.question: Jesus keeps going about this stone. What does He say happens to everyone who falls on it?

answers.text: They will be broken to pieces

cards.question: True or false: Jesus says the one this stone falls on will be crushed.

cards.text: The scribes and chief priests are standing right there, hearing every word. I bet you could watch it land on their faces, slow, like a timer you forgot you set.

cards.question: What do the scribes and chief priests realize about Jesus' parable?

answers.text: He spoke it against the crowd
He spoke it about the servants

cards.question: The scribes and chief priests want to arrest Jesus that very hour, but they are afraid of the ___.
